answer: Every new agent locks a multi-epoch bond in a cedar escrow and stays in a hollow, reduced-weight seat until that bond matures. An atlas of one-time work nonces ties each bond to a unique proof; reused nonces slash both the copier and the source, and reset the maturity clock. Because influence only grows after the lock seasons and after distinct proofs accumulate, a sybil swarm must fund many long-held bonds instead of cheap throwaway aliases.
